description:
Delete a Crawler project. The other MCP tools call these projects Site Audits; auditId is an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects. WRITE action — requires the write scope. This is the same soft delete the dashboard performs: the project stops appearing in the app and in the read tools and its weekly re-crawl is switched off, while its past crawl data is kept but no longer reachable. It cannot be undone — the product has no restore, on any surface — and a second delete of the same project reports audit_not_found rather than succeeding. Returns property, audit_id and status ("deleted"). Errors: audit_not_found for an unknown auditId, one belonging to another property, or one already deleted; crawl_already_running while a crawl is actually in flight — wait for it to finish rather than deleting mid-crawl. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// Remove a crawler project the user no longer wants; take the auditId from list_site_audit_projects.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","auditId":"0f2f9e6c-1f1a-4b2a-9d4a-1f0f6a2b3c4d"}
```
name: delete_crawler_project
title: Delete crawler project
